title: StudioUISchema
description: SuperSpace Studio UI Layout document schema v0.4/v0.5

version.description: Schema version. New documents must use '0.5'.

root.description: Ordered list of top-level node IDs.

nodes.description: All nodes keyed by stable node ID.

NodeId.description: kebab-case node ID: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Must start with a letter.

type.description: Widget type key. Must be a registered type.

props.description: Widget props. Content validated per-widget by runtime validator.

children.description: Ordered child node IDs. Runtime validator checks existence and graph invariants.

note:runtime-only-rules: All root IDs must exist in nodes (UNKNOWN_ROOT_ID)
All children IDs must exist in nodes (UNKNOWN_CHILD_ID)
Each node may appear in at most one parent's children (MULTIPLE_PARENTS)
Root nodes must not appear as children (ROOT_HAS_PARENT)
All nodes must be reachable from root (ORPHAN_NODE)
Smart blocks may not contain smart blocks (SMART_BLOCK_NESTING)
